36	1. Show log3/log4 irrational: assume log3/log4 = a/b → 3^b = 4^a → Coprime(3,4) contradiction
37	2. Apply: Real.exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le (Dirichlet theorem in Mathlib)

44	lemma exists_k_m_ratio_close (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
45	    ∃ k m : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ 0 < m ∧ |↑k * log 3 - ↑m * log 4| < ε := by
46	  have hlog3_pos : (0 : ℝ) < log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
47	  have hlog4_pos : (0 : ℝ) < log 4 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
48	  have hirr : Irrational (log 3 / log 4) := by
49	    rw [irrational_iff_ne_rational]
50	    intro a b hb heq
51	    -- show b*log3 = a*log4 → 3^b.natAbs = 4^a.natAbs → Coprime contradiction
52	    sorry
53	  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (log 4 / ε)
54	  obtain ⟨j, k, hk_pos, _, hbound⟩ :=
55	    Real.exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le (log 3 / log 4) (Nat.succ_pos N)
56	  refine ⟨k.toNat, j.toNat, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
57	  -- rearrange and bound: |k*log3 - j*log4| = log4 * |k*(log3/log4) - j| < ε

LEAN_PROJECT="${RRMA_LEAN_PROJECT:-$HOME/rrma-lean}"
AGENT="${CLAUDE_AGENT_ID:-agent0}"
export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"

WORKSPACE_FILE="$DOMAIN_DIR/workspace/$AGENT/Erdos125.lean"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE_FILE" ]; then
    SOLUTION="$WORKSPACE_FILE"
else
    SOLUTION="$DOMAIN_DIR/Erdos125.lean"
fi

if [ ! -f "$SOLUTION" ]; then
    echo "SCORE=0.0"
    echo "STATUS: Erdos125.lean not found"
    exit 0
fi

SORRY_COUNT=$(grep -v '^\s*--' "$SOLUTION" | grep -c "sorry" 2>/dev/null) || true
SORRY_COUNT=${SORRY_COUNT:-0}

TMP_FILE="$LEAN_PROJECT/Erdos125Test_${AGENT}_$$.lean"

cd "$LEAN_PROJECT"
set +e
